reason: Checked and confirmed. At the 07:02:42Z poll header, 47, 48, 49 and 50 are all PENDING (ledger.md l.20-23). Only 1 slot is left on 28 Sep, and W2b (12:00Z) and W3 (<=23:30Z) are the same slot. Probe 50 (exp85a, 05:02:30Z) is in the same family as exp70g (dummy 1388 s vs 1409 s). exp70g's L is (7.49, 7.67] h, so 50's terminal header lands at ~12:32-12:53Z. 47, 49 and 48 (CI) all read before 12:00Z, so 50 is the only read still missing at the W2b decision. Waiting ~45 min makes every W1+50 read available. It costs no slot and does not reduce E10 priority. A non-CI file sent by 13:30Z still reads by ~21:20Z, before W4 at 00:05Z. The CONTEXT inconsistency is real: the 04:38Z entry moves exp80a/exp81 to W3/W4, while the 06:26Z entry sends W2b back to W2 v4 (2), which includes exp81. The rule adds no lever and no file. It only lets the existing choice see one more read, so it weakly dominates deciding blind. Weaknesses, none fatal. (a) Branch (3) points to an exp85a lookup row whose stacks (exp83h/exp82d) are neither built nor gated; it depends on PC24-02/03. (b) The exp86a/b dummy gates (pushed 06:36Z) are not logged yet. (c) A CI file sent at ~12:50Z could read as late as ~23:40Z. (d) The rule needs a live main session at 12:30-13:30Z; the previous session died at 05:07Z. (e) Value on private is unproven. The K lever is +0.001 per knob on one public embryo, and our lab had the sign wrong. But this finding only fixes the timing and makes no claim that K helps.
fix: Write the line NOW, before 47 is terminal (~07:30Z), so that its DIV clause is pre-score too. Use the finding's text with these edits. (1) T = the earlier of 50's terminal header and 13:30Z. (2) Branches (2) and (3) apply only if the named file's dummy has PASSED a gate logged before T; exp86a/b are gated vs exp78a/exp78b with the exp85a-style checks. Otherwise go to the next branch; never wait past 13:30Z for a dummy. (3) Branch (3) with no built and passed exp85a stack: build exp85a+CI/SEC and send it as the W3 file by 23:30Z (W2 v4 (2)(v)) only if its dummy passes by 23:00Z. Otherwise use W2 v4 (2) on the current lookup. (4) If W2 v4 (2)(i) selects a CI stack, submit it at T without extra delay (CI latency is up to 10.9 h). (5) State that the 04:38Z 'exp80a/exp81 move to W3/W4' is superseded and exp81 stays eligible under (ii). (6) OPS: the main session keeps the poller and a wake-up at ~12:30Z and 13:30Z (detached processes, as restarted at 06:22Z). If no session is live at 13:30Z, the slot moves to W3 under (v) and is not lost.
realistic_gain: Process only; no direct LB gain. If 50 reads + (display >= 0.957; the outside record suggests maybe ~30-50%), it avoids a blind W2b pick and lets the last 28 Sep slot read an informed K or DIV+K stack by ~21:20Z, ahead of the W4 planning. That might add +0.001 public on the file chosen for the finals pool. Private effect unknown (one public embryo). The cost is ~0.5-1.5 h of later read on this one file.
